sections.title: What is the LIC Jeevan Utsav plan?

content.text: LIC Jeevan Utsav is a Non-Linked, Non-Participating, Individual, Savings, Whole Life Insurance plan. It offers a limited premium payment term (5 to 16 years) but provides lifelong benefits. The key feature is the guaranteed additions that accrue during the premium paying term. After the PPT, the policyholder receives a lifetime income through one of two options: Regular Income (a fixed 10% of the Basic Sum Assured annually) or Flexi Income (where the income can be accumulated and grow at an interest rate of 5.5% p.a.). For more official details, you can refer to the official LIC page.

Premium & Mode Conversion

We start with the base annual premium and then apply LIC's official modal loading factors to calculate half-yearly, quarterly, and monthly premiums.

Guaranteed Additions (GAs)

GAs are calculated at a rate of ₹40 per ₹1,000 Basic Sum Assured at the end of each policy year, but only during the Premium Paying Term (PPT). After the PPT, no more GAs accrue. Example: For a ₹10 Lakh BSA, the annual GA is (10,00,000 / 1000) * 40 = ₹40,000.

Income Options

  • Regular Income: A straightforward payout of 10% of your Basic Sum Assured, paid to you every year for life after the PPT ends.
  • Flexi Income: Instead of taking the 10% payout, you can let it accumulate with LIC. This unclaimed amount grows at a guaranteed, compounding interest rate of 5.5% p.a. You can withdraw up to 75% of this accumulated balance in a financial year.

Death Benefit

The death benefit is the higher of the 'Sum Assured on Death' or 105% of total premiums paid. The 'Sum Assured on Death' is itself the higher of the Basic Sum Assured or 7 times the annualized premium.

items.q: Regular vs Flexi Income — which is better?
items.a: Choose 'Regular' if you need a fixed, predictable annual income. Choose 'Flexi' if you don't need the money immediately and want it to grow in a tax-efficient manner at 5.5% p.a., giving you the flexibility to withdraw later.

items.q: What is the minimum Sum Assured?
items.a: The minimum Basic Sum Assured for Jeevan Utsav is ₹5,00,000.

items.q: Can I take a loan on this policy?
items.a: Yes, a loan is available after the policy has acquired a surrender value, which is typically after paying premiums for two full years.

As a whole life plan, Jeevan Utsav technically matures at age 100. The primary benefit is the lifetime income stream that starts after the premium paying term ends, not a single lump sum maturity payout like traditional endowment plans.

To be precise, it's a guaranteed annual income equal to 10% of your Basic Sum Assured, not a 10% return on your investment (IRR). For the Flexi option, the 5.5% interest on the accumulated, unwithdrawn income is guaranteed.

sections.title: Conclusion: A Lifelong Income Stream for a Secure Future

content.text: LIC's Jeevan Utsav is a powerful tool for anyone seeking a guaranteed, lifelong income stream after a limited premium payment period. Whether you choose the predictable 'Regular Income' or the flexible 'Flexi Income' option to grow your wealth, this plan is an excellent choice for creating a secure, lifelong financial legacy. It's best suited for individuals looking for a reliable, non-market-linked income stream in their post-retirement years, combining savings and protection in one powerful package.

mainEntity.name: What are Guaranteed Additions in Jeevan Utsav?

acceptedAnswer.text: Guaranteed Additions accrue @ ₹40 per ₹1,000 Basic Sum Assured at the end of each policy year during the premium paying term only.

mainEntity.name: What is the Regular vs Flexi Income?

acceptedAnswer.text: Regular Income pays 10% of BSA each year for life after PPT. Flexi allows you to defer income; unclaimed income accrues @ ~5.5% p.a. compounding, with up to 75% withdrawal per year.
